changes: Discovery does not refresh or unmount ProviderSettings; pending model rows remain available for explicit capability confirmation.
Original-operation recovery consumes the complete discovery/application receipt and checks operation identity, provider kind/revision, current intent and mounted scope.
Only applied=true and requiresConfirmation=false for the live application intent triggers the parent callback; native catalog discovery does not claim an application.
Unknown and accepted-but-unusable recovery results keep duplicate discovery/application gated; no operation is automatically replayed.
